principle: The live course evolves after teaching and weekly preview/reflection.
upgrade_rule: A later course rebuild from newer Banks MUST preserve teacher_live resources unless the user explicitly asks to replace/remove them.
bank_reflection_rule: Teacher-live resources do not need to be backported into Banks merely to survive a course upgrade.
merge_strategy: Regenerate bank_derived resources; refresh framework_generated resources when appropriate; preserve teacher_live paths/content and reconnect them to navigation if needed.
legacy_unlinked_paths: ideas/ (preserve teacher-live content if present; no longer linked by current dashboard)
activities_rule: Framework-generated Activities may be rebuilt when requested, but teacher-created/revised or explicitly teacher_live Activities must survive later course/Bank upgrades unless the teacher explicitly replaces them.
